main_text.p: do Sacerdotium illud Θεοψήφισον[?] fuit, ex quo tot mala Græciæ prognata sunt. Sed vt fuerit examinetur. Photiani ipsi non negant, Ignatium legitime in thronum Constanti-nopolitanum euectum fuisse. Is per vim eijcitur a Photio, quo eiecto ipse Bardæ & Imperatoris Michaëlis patrocinio fultus Se-dem occupat. Hæc quoque sunt Schisma-ticorum effata. Photius ergo inuasor est, lupus in gregem alienum intrusus. Et Pho-tius iste homo acerrimus bonorum alieno-rum possessor, expulsor, ereptor, nobis Θεοψήφισον[?] fuerit? Horas bonas esset per-dere, si in his probandis diutius immorare-mur'. Adeantur Nicetas Paphlago in vita Ignatij, Acta Octauæ Synodi, & Libelli Episcoporum in ea contenti, Acta Synodo-rum Romanarum sub Nicolao, & Adriano Pontificibus Romanis, Styliani Neocæsa-riensis Epistola ad Stephanum Papam. Et ne singulos recenseam, Georgius Cedrenus damnationem Ignatij, & electionem Pho-tij vocat, Ταῦτα γὰρ τὰ τῆς φιλοσοφωτάτης τῷ Βαρ-δᾷ πανουργήματα[?]. Hæc sunt facinora, quæ Bar-das imperij obtinendi cupiditate impulsus edidit. Ioannes Zonaras inter alia supra modum vi-tuperanda, & detestanda Bardæ enumerat, Τὰ δ' ἄλλα καὶ ἄλλα ψιλά[?], ἐ ἐκπέψασα[?], Matthæ-us Cygala in Synopsi historica, Τὸ μὲν ὀλίγον

page.notes: Ink blots and stains at the left edge, at the lower right (near the catchword) and beside line 3 ("examinetur"); not printed text, so left out. The Greek on the lines "Ταῦτα ... Βαρ-" and "Τὰ δ' ἄλλα ..." is hard to read from the scan; the readings are best guesses with [?]. The word "Θεοψήφισον" at lines 1 and 13 is also uncertain. The "?" after "examinetur" may be ink, not a printed mark; I did not transcribe it. The apostrophe after "immorare-mur" is read as printed. Possibly printed error: "Θεοψήφισον" (in both places). The catchword "ἐξ-" is read from the lower right and is uncertain.
